We have a template ID (reaction_id) 1914386. Need to construct retrosynthesis route JSON: root molecule target SMILES: COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O

We need a single reaction step using this template. Children are precursor molecules: from the template's reactant_smiles: "O=[C:5]([C:3]([O:2][CH3:1])=[O:4])[CH2:6][CH2:7][c:8]1[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]1.[CH:14]#[C:15][Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]"

We need to convert to SMILES without atom mapping: first part is a methyl ester? Let's decode: O=[C]([C]([O][CH3])=O)[CH2][CH2]c1ccccc1 . That's methyl 4-(2-(trimethylsilyl)ethynyl)phenylacetate? Actually the first fragment: O=C( C( OCH3)=O )CH2CH2c1ccccc1 . That's methyl 4-(2-(trimethylsilyl)ethynyl)phenylacetate? Wait the phenyl is attached to CH2CH2. So it's phenethyl acetate? Actually O=C( C( OCH3)=O )CH2CH2c1ccccc1 is methyl 2-phenylethyl acetate? No, O=C( C( OCH3)=O ) is methyl acetate carbonyl attached to CH2CH2 phenyl. So it's methyl 2-phenylethyl acetate (phenethyl acetate). The second fragment: [CH]#[C][Si](CH3)(CH3)CH3 is trimethylsilylacetylene (TMS-acetylene). So precursors: phenethyl acetate (SMILES: COC(=O)CCc1ccccc1) and TMS-acetylene (SMILES: C#C[Si](C)(C)C). Let's verify: phenethyl acetate SMILES: CCOC(=O)CCc1ccccc1? Actually methyl phenethyl acetate: CH3O-C(=O)-CH2-CH2-Ph. That's "COC(=O)CCc1ccccc1". Yes.

TMS-acetylene: "C#C[Si](C)(C)C". Good.

Now we need to output JSON route: root mol with target smiles, children list with one reaction node: type reaction, template_id maybe use reaction_id 1914386 (or template_id field expects ID). Use that ID. Children of reaction are two mol nodes with SMILES of precursors.

Thus final answer JSON.
